comparison.objective: Sweep cereal pieces into a held-flat dustpan; candidate separates mixed industrial solids through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual brushing and lip management versus pouring, screen load sharing, bounded agitation, and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: All cereal in the pan with tools released versus ≥98% media in receiver while every washer remains in screen and no particle is lost.
comparison.reason: Both collect many loose objects, but sweeping indiscriminately into a pan does not test size-selective aperture flow.
